address: InterContinental Abu Dhabi, King Abdullah bin Abdul Aziz Al Saud Street, Abu Dhabi
bio: Start your visit on the wonderful terrace and spend time admiring, or indeed coveting, the boats bobbing in the marina that it overlooks. Sharing is everything at this two-level restaurant, where the service is affable and organised. The Lebanese menu offers bags of choice – the grilled section is a good place to head to, where lamb-lovers should look no further than machawi mchakaleh. Friday and Saturday evenings see live music and entertainment.
